title: A Moral Imperative: The Need for Continual Superalignment of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper explicitly frames the alignment of superintelligent AI with human values as a 'moral imperative' and discusses the complexities of encoding evolving human ethical norms and societal values into LLMs. It uses the qualitative shift in legal/ethical standards (e.g., affirmative action) as a primary evaluation case study.
